top_reviews.title: Great smartwatch!
top_reviews.variant: Color: Cream Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: This is my very first smartwatch, and I bought it mainly for step tracking. But I quickly realized how convenient it is to be able to read messages and answer phone calls right from my watch, especially when I have no idea where I left my phone. :-) I was a little worried that I would have to charge it every single day because I had read reviews about some of the older models. But surprisingly, I only need to charge my watch about once every three days. Even more impressive, it takes only about 1–1.5 hours to fully charge. The watch band is on the smaller side, which was the first thing I noticed when I received it. My wrist is pretty skinny, though, so it fits me perfectly — almost like it was made for me! :-) And even if you have a wider wrist, there are plenty of compatible bands available on Amazon in different colors and sizes. I pre-ordered my watch before the release date, so I also received a $50 gift card, which was a really nice bonus. Overall, this was a great purchase, and I’m really happy I got it!

top_reviews.title: Great new functions!
top_reviews.variant: Color: Graphite Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: I've been very happy with this model compared to my original galaxy watch 8 and it was well worth the money for the upgraded functions! I've had zero connectivity issues with the watch and every feature has worked perfect for my health tracking needs. The size I chose fit perfect for me and has been very enjoyable to use overall! I will say the biggest reason for the upgrade was the new features which compile information much better than previous models and present it in a more easy to read manner! I'll gladly stick with samsung watchs because of usability and durability compared to other brands!

top_reviews.title: Great Upgrade from Galaxy Watch 5
top_reviews.variant: Color: Cream Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: As someone who loved her Galaxy Watch 5, I was very excited to finally upgrade to the Watch 9. My old watch finally died this week, which seemed like perfect timing with the new coming out (though I wish I could have taken advantage of pre-order deals but alas). Luckily, I was able to get a replacement pretty quickly and in a color I liked as well. First, I have to say that while I love my watch, it was a bit of a panic attack at first, as the setup was way different from my first watch. As someone who mostly used her watch for productivity tasks, step tracking, and heart rate monitoring during workouts, I found all the new fitness-tracking features extremely overwhelming. I almost sent it back because I wasn't sure if I wanted all these options. Since I didn't want to put up with the lack of functionality and durability of the Fitbit, I decided to stick it out and just turn off some of the features. It was better to have them in case I wanted them later. Once I got my watch working, though, I was very impressed. The fit has been great and it seems more durable than my old watch. The only disappointing thing about it has been that it doesn't work with any of my old Galaxy Watch chargers, which is annoying since I will have to buy new ones. Fairly minor, but still disappointing. I also love that there are so many band options (I personally am not a fan of silicone bands). Overall though, I love the color of my watch and how it feels, and consider it a good value for the money.

top_reviews.title: It could have been 5 stars.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Graphite Size: 44mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: The Samsung Watch 9 is a good-looking watch. I find its thin design is much better looking than the new bulky/thick Samsung Ultra2. This watch looks gorgeous, feels well made, is easy to read and is bright enough at 3000 nits. The Watch 9 is also very comfortable to wear. The new silicone strap makes this possible. I am excited to see the previous strap is gone. The old strap was uncomfortable and always difficult to put on. I was never fond of the previous folding-in strap design. I have experienced battery life from 2 to 3 days which I find acceptable. The watch is turned off when not in use. The biggest problem with the watch is that its charging method is not backwards compatible. It will not charge on my existing wireless charger or charge from the puck of my previous Samsung watch. So, if you do not have a usb-c charger lying around for the included puck, you need to buy that as well. The charging puck included with the Watch 9 has a different charging configuration than what was used in Samsung's previous generations. While on the subject of charging, I noticed that even if the watch is turned off prior to charging, the Watch 9 will boot itself up again while charging. I find this very irritating. Due to this, I now have to remember to turn the watch off AFTER it is fully charged. Maybe it's me, but I do not want the watch to be constantly on when not in use. Charging time is about 2 hours (from 20% to 100% charge). I would have given this watch 5 stars, if it were not for the charging issues I have encountered.

top_reviews.title: Perfect watch face size but small band.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Graphite Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: Perfect watch face size for an average womans wrist size, but the band with the 40mm watch is very small, i could only use it with the last hole and it was tight. I bought the bluetooth version for the health tracking features which I love so far but am still getting used to them. I noticed once I turned the health tracking features on the battery runs down faster. I probably went from charging every 1.5-2 days to once a day and that is with the AOD off. For example, I had it charged to 100% around 9:00 am, and with normal activity throughout the day it is now at 52% at 6:55 pm. Fast response times; great health tracking features with vitals, sleep tracking, automatic workout detection; and it had a bright clear display. I just wish the battery lasted a tad longer.

top_reviews.title: Good battery life.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Cream Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: I've had my watch for a while and really like it. You can get different bands for them. The watch is easy to use. It's big and I had to get used to that. Battery life is good.

top_reviews.title: Love it!
top_reviews.variant: Color: Cream Size: 40mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: I went from another brand to this and I love it! Love the size of the screen. So many features that I am still trying to figure out. Battery only lasts about a day, but with so many features, thats understandable. Love all the measurements it takes too!

top_reviews.title: Get yours today!
top_reviews.variant: Color: Graphite Size: 44mm Style: Bluetooth Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: Terrific watch. Upgraded from the Galaxy 6 to the Galaxy 9. Wow! It was worth it. The band fits better than the 6. It doesn't seem to weigh anymore than the 6. Charge time is about the same and lasts about 2 days before needing a recharge. Many more choices for a customized watch face.

top_reviews.title: Not Recommended. Wait for Galaxy Watch 10 or 11 LTE or get Watch 8 LTE.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Silver Size: 44mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch9 Only
top_reviews.body: Not recommended! I've had to change my opinion of the Galaxy Watch 9 LTE after some time with it. Best to wait for the Watch 10 or 11 LTE for hopefully a much bigger silicon-carbon battery and several other needed changes. The latest round is discovering Samsung apparently started selling these watches without the ability to buy spare charging pucks anywhere retail! The existing puck for Galaxy Watch 5/6/7 (and maybe 8? can't confirm) does NOT work with Watch 9 LTE. Comes up with a yellow triangle "incompatible charger" symbol. After time speaking on the phone with Samsung Customer Service I was able to order what is supposed to be one through Samsung Parts, run by Encompass (part# GH96-17240A). Having spare car & office pucks for a watch with a battery that only lasts for a day is crucial. I have two spare pucks for my old Galaxy Watch 5 Pro for that reason. UPDATE 9/23/26! THIS JUST GOT WORSE. No word on the Watch 9 charging puck order, so I called Samsung Parts for status to learn it is now BACKORDERED UNTIL 11/14/26 and worse they say that is just an estimate, could be longer. :( Two MONTHS from when I placed the order for something that should have been available when the watch came out. :( Wow. The alarm volume on the Watch 9 has turned out to be so soft I can barely hear it. I've had to go back to my old Watch 5 Pro for timing the yard sprinklers and such. I can hear that one in the next room. The "M/L" watch band is woefully short, as many others have posted now. It should be a "M". Samsung needs to make an "L" available and ideally an "XL". The band can be replaced for some other brand, but it is the principle of the thing. For $450, a large company like Samsung should have a properly sized watch bands available to ship with the watch. The Watch 5 Pro band has the same problem. Nothing screams "excess profit" like this issue, IMHO. :( The battery life is a joke, as many people have posted, lasting around 24 hours when many other watches will go for days. The battery life in my old Watch 5 Pro is even less, about 18 hours, so I figured that I would get used to it, but hasn't happened. Especially irritating knowing silicon carbon batteries with much greater capacity are out there. One of the reasons I hung on to my old Galaxy 5 Pro for so long is that the glass display is completely surrounded by round metal and therefore chip-proof. Well sure enough this display already has an edge chip on it. :( The Watch 9 does have a few good things still. I bought it to get LTE so I could make an emergency phone call if the phone isn't around. That still works via the Spectrum Mobile $11/month watch add-on plan. The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth versions are updated from the Watch 5 Pro and work better. And the biggee: the aluminum Watch 9 is light enough to wear all day long where the titanium Watch 5 Pro wasn't, without becoming annoying. But even then the Watch 9 LTE is 80% the same as the Watch 8 LTE! The case size, display, memory, and bio-sensors are all the same. Might was well get a cheaper (used, even) Watch 8 LTE to carry over to the watch 10 or 11. I'll be looking forward to trading-in this Watch 9 LTE the minute Samsung comes up with a bigger-battery LTE watch that will go a minimum of 2 days on a charge. Also looking for Watch 10 or 11 to have 5G rather than just LTE, Wi-Fi 7 & 6GHz vs. just Wi-Fi 6, and satellite communication - which the Snapdragon Wear Elite chip in it already supports. C'mon Samsung, time to step up your game here. :(

Which colors are available for Galaxy Watch Ultra2?
Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is available in Titanium Silver and Titanium Gray.
Is the titanium body tough enough for scratches and impacts during outdoor activities?
Galaxy Watch Ultra2’s titanium body is built to take impact head-on while staying light on your wrist, so it moves naturally with you during extended wear. It resists scratches, dents and wear without adding bulk.
Can I wear the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 while swimming in a pool or in the ocean?
Yes. With 10 ATM water resistance6 and EN13319 certification, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is built for the water.⁶,⁷ You can wear it confidently while swimming or diving in the pool or open water, down to 40 meters.11
What does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 track during a dive? How deep can it go?
Galaxy Watch Ultra2 tracks your current depth, elapsed dive time and water temperature in real time, helping you stay aware of the changing conditions underwater down to 40 meters.11
My Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is charging slowly, do I have to use the charger that comes with it?
The Galaxy Watch Ultra2 comes with a charger that is specific to its model, and it charges best using only that charger. To get the best charging performance, use provided wireless charger that comes in the box.

top_reviews.title: Solid fitness watch really enjoying it
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: The watch is very comfortable. User interface is simple to learn. I came from a Garmin Fenix 7X the display on this is a lot better, however, battery needs to be charged every day or 2 , so adjusting to that which is no big deal. This watch is good value for money, it's somewhat expensive but you get what you pay for it's very durable and tough. It has new trail running feature sounds good haven't tried it. The fit is great , got the silicone band with plenty of double holes throughout the band. Appearance... Looks good feels good, and surprisingly light for such a tough watch. I have a s 25 ultra phone so it works great... I was having a connectivity issue at first it wasn't connecting then I realized I needed to disconnect my gaming head set and I was able to connect it. Just keep an eye out if you have other blue tooth connected to your phone, turn off that blue tooth first then connect watch. It's a fairly easy watch to learn and performs great for aerobics easy to read heart rate zones nice and clear. If your a Samsung fan, this watch is an easy pick for your health needs or if you just want convenience for notifications, calls on your watch etc.

top_reviews.title: Pleased so far.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: Soo, I waited a while before writing this. My goal buying the watch was health and fitness. The ultra 2 had the features that I wanted. I had also used the Samsung Health app in my phone so I was comfortable with the experience. Previously, I had two Fitbits. I liked them but the battery life was poor. I also disliked the need to subscribe for advanced features. Overall I didn't think the Fitbit was a good value for its life expectancy either. The ultra 2 with plastic band it's actually comfortable to wear. Ive worn it while sweaty with no issues. I am also okay with the size. I like the titanium color a lot too. Truth be told I'd wound up covering the watch with a protective ring so it probably doesn't matter as much. I did think that some of the colors started to wear within the first week. However I have a history of being rough on watches. I just have it connected to my phone via Bluetooth which is good enough for me. It seems like most of the apps are better on the phone anyway. I haven't tested the water resistance but it seems like it would be all right. The big question is battery life. For my use I can typically get two to three days out of it. Easily a day with a lot of use and interactions. The church is quickly so it's easy to top it off it points the day where I don't need to wear it. I do like to have it wearable at night. So far no disappointments. No surprises. I know there are watches with longer battery life which is a good thing to have. Many of those cost more. And many of them don't have the other health features that I really need for day to day use. I still think I could use the Ultra 2 for longer backpacking trips with a little consideration. The photo shows my watch with her screen protector and bezel protector.

top_reviews.title: Expensive but good watch with excellent battery life.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Silver Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: Expensive, but this is a good watch. Battery lasts more than a day. I have a narrow wrist and the bezel is quite large, but you get used to it. I am having a problem calibrating the watches BP monitor.

top_reviews.title: This watch is very expensive beware however it's worth every penny
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: This watch is absolutely amazing, I realize the price is extremely high but the functions are incredible It does blood pressure more accurate than any other watch I've seen or had and I've tried 10 different varieties The lower cost ones don't even come close The features and the amount of detail information it gives are absolutely phenomenal I would give it 6 stars if I could

top_reviews.title: Long battery life
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: This watch is great! It has a long battery life and it's possible to get 3 days of battery life. And it charges fast. You will have to have a charger block that fits a c to c cord. You have full control over the watch display and can customize it to your liking. It is water proof and has a swimming feature that you can turn on and it ejects any water that may have gotten into the speakers.

top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: The watch itself was great but we could not get to connect through Verizon, had to return it .

Being able to go 3 days without charging has been wonderful especially with the always on display. My only real complaint is with the included watch band. The end likes to escape out of the holders.

What does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 track during a dive? How deep can it go?

top_reviews.title: Solid fitness watch really enjoying it
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: The watch is very comfortable. User interface is simple to learn. I came from a Garmin Fenix 7X the display on this is a lot better, however, battery needs to be charged every day or 2 , so adjusting to that which is no big deal. This watch is good value for money, it's somewhat expensive but you get what you pay for it's very durable and tough. It has new trail running feature sounds good haven't tried it. The fit is great , got the silicone band with plenty of double holes throughout the band. Appearance... Looks good feels good, and surprisingly light for such a tough watch. I have a s 25 ultra phone so it works great... I was having a connectivity issue at first it wasn't connecting then I realized I needed to disconnect my gaming head set and I was able to connect it. Just keep an eye out if you have other blue tooth connected to your phone, turn off that blue tooth first then connect watch. It's a fairly easy watch to learn and performs great for aerobics easy to read heart rate zones nice and clear. If your a Samsung fan, this watch is an easy pick for your health needs or if you just want convenience for notifications, calls on your watch etc.

top_reviews.title: Pleased so far.
top_reviews.variant: Color: Titanium Gray Size: 47mm Style: Cellular Pattern Name: Watch Ultra 2 Only
top_reviews.body: Soo, I waited a while before writing this. My goal buying the watch was health and fitness. The ultra 2 had the features that I wanted. I had also used the Samsung Health app in my phone so I was comfortable with the experience. Previously, I had two Fitbits. I liked them but the battery life was poor. I also disliked the need to subscribe for advanced features. Overall I didn't think the Fitbit was a good value for its life expectancy either. The ultra 2 with plastic band it's actually comfortable to wear. Ive worn it while sweaty with no issues. I am also okay with the size. I like the titanium color a lot too. Truth be told I'd wound up covering the watch with a protective ring so it probably doesn't matter as much. I did think that some of the colors started to wear within the first week. However I have a history of being rough on watches. I just have it connected to my phone via Bluetooth which is good enough for me. It seems like most of the apps are better on the phone anyway. I haven't tested the water resistance but it seems like it would be all right. The big question is battery life. For my use I can typically get two to three days out of it. Easily a day with a lot of use and interactions. The church is quickly so it's easy to top it off it points the day where I don't need to wear it. I do like to have it wearable at night. So far no disappointments. No surprises. I know there are watches with longer battery life which is a good thing to have. Many of those cost more. And many of them don't have the other health features that I really need for day to day use. I still think I could use the Ultra 2 for longer backpacking trips with a little consideration. The photo shows my watch with her screen protector and bezel protector.
